title: Cognition to Control - Multi-Agent Learning for Human-Humanoid Collaborative Transport
abstract: arXiv:2603.03768v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Full-stack human-robot collaboration (HRC) can become brittle when replacing a planner, partner model, coordination policy, or controller changes the physical meaning of cross-layer signals. We introduce C2C, an object-centric cognition-to-control architecture that preserves these meanings through physical contracts. Rather than standardizing individual modules, C2C standardizes the physical semantics exchanged between them: task intent is represented by a geometrically verified payload path, partner information by a source-independent physical state, learned coordination by bounded 11-D task-space commands, and robot-specific feasibility remains inside whole-body control (WBC). The reference system combines a vision-language model with deterministic geometric verification and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for partner-aware coordination. Across nine transport scenarios, adaptive MARL variants achieve 77.1-82.1% mean

translated_title: 从认知到控制——面向人-人形机器人协同搬运的多智能体学习
translated_abstract: 全栈人机协作（HRC）在更换规划器、伙伴模型、协调策略或控制器时，可能因跨层信号物理含义的改变而变得脆弱。我们提出C2C，一种以物体为中心的“认知到控制”架构，通过物理契约来保持这些含义。C2C并不对单个模块进行标准化，而是对模块之间交换的物理语义进行标准化：任务意图由经过几何验证的负载路径表示，伙伴信息由与来源无关的物理状态表示，学习到的协调由有界的11维任务空间指令表示，而机器人特定的可行性则保留在全身控制（WBC）内部。参考系统将视觉-语言模型与确定性几何验证以及多智能体强化学习（MARL）相结合，实现具备伙伴感知能力的协调。在九种搬运场景中，自适应MARL变体实现了77.1-82.1%的平均（成功率）……
tldr: 提出C2C架构，通过物理契约标准化人-人形协作系统各层之间交换的物理语义，并结合视觉-语言模型、几何验证与多智能体强化学习，实现模块可替换且稳健的人机协同搬运。
en_tdlr: C2C is an object-centric cognition-to-control architecture that standardizes the physical semantics exchanged between HRC layers via physical contracts, combining vision-language models, geometric verification, and MARL for robust, module-swappable human-humanoid collaborative transport.
